name: Sentry
description: Integrate Sentry to manage your error tracking and monitoring.

tools.name: Access project information
tools.description: Retrieves detailed information for a Sentry project, given its existing organization and project ID or slug.

inputs.name: project_id_or_slug
inputs.about: ID or slug of the Sentry project.

inputs.name: organization_id_or_slug
inputs.about: ID or slug of the Sentry organization to which the project belongs.

tools.name: Add a symbol source to a project
tools.description: Tool to add a custom symbol source to a Sentry project. Use when configuring symbol sources for crash symbolication.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: Internal ID of the source. Must be distinct and cannot start with 'sentry:'. UUID generated if not provided.

inputs.name: url
inputs.about: Source URL. Required for HTTP sources.

inputs.name: name
inputs.about: Human-readable name of the source.

inputs.name: type
inputs.about: Source type. Options: 'http' (SymbolServer HTTP), 'gcs' (Google Cloud Storage), 's3' (Amazon S3).

inputs.name: bucket
inputs.about: Bucket name. Required for S3 and GCS sources.

inputs.name: prefix
inputs.about: S3 or GCS prefix path.

inputs.name: region
inputs.about: AWS region enumeration for S3 sources.

inputs.name: password
inputs.about: Password for HTTP authentication.

inputs.name: username
inputs.about: Username for HTTP authentication.

inputs.name: access_key
inputs.about: AWS Access Key. Required for S3 sources.

inputs.name: secret_key
inputs.about: AWS Secret Access Key. Required for S3 sources.

inputs.name: private_key
inputs.about: GCS private key. Required for GCS sources.

inputs.name: client_email
inputs.about: GCS email for authentication. Required for GCS sources.

inputs.name: layout__type
inputs.about: Layout type specifying the directory structure for symbols. Required for HTTP, GCS, and S3 sources.

inputs.name: layout__casing
inputs.about: Filename casing convention for symbols. Required for HTTP, GCS, and S3 sources.

inputs.name: filters__filetypes
inputs.about: List of file types to filter.

inputs.name: project_id_or_slug
inputs.about: The ID or slug of the project.

inputs.name: filters__path_patterns
inputs.about: Glob patterns for debug/code file paths.

inputs.name: organization_id_or_slug
inputs.about: The ID or slug of the organization.

inputs.name: filters__requires_checksum
inputs.about: Whether source requires debug checksum. Default: false.

tools.name: Add organization member via email
tools.description: Invites a new member (or re-invites an existing non-accepted member) to a Sentry organization via email, allowing specification of organization and team roles.

inputs.name: email
inputs.about: The email address of the user to invite or add to the organization.

inputs.name: orgRole
inputs.about: Primary organization-level role. `billing`: Manages payment/compliance. `member`: Views events/data. `manager`: Manages teams, projects, membership. `owner`: Unrestricted access. `admin`: Edits global integrations, manages projects/teams. Note: The `admin` role may have plan-specific restrictions; c

inputs.name: reinvite
inputs.about: If `True`, resends an invitation to a user previously invited but who has not yet accepted.

inputs.name: teamRoles
inputs.about: List of team-specific role assignments. Common roles: `contributor` (views/acts on issues, may add members per org settings) and `admin` (full team/project management).

inputs.name: sendInvite
inputs.about: If `True`, an invitation email is sent to the user. Set to `False` to add the member without an email notification.

inputs.name: organization_id_or_slug
inputs.about: The unique identifier (ID or slug) of the Sentry organization to which the member will be added.

tools.name: Add or remove user email by id
tools.description: Adds or removes a secondary email for an existing Sentry user, determined by whether the email already exists for that user.

inputs.name: email
inputs.about: The email address to be added to or removed from the user's Sentry account. Ensure this is a valid email format.

inputs.name: user_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the Sentry user (e.g., numeric ID or 'self') for whom the email address is being managed.

tools.name: Add team member in organization
tools.description: Adds an existing organization member to one of its teams, or may generate an access request when permission to join is needed. An already-existing membership is reported as an error.

inputs.name: member_id
inputs.about: ID of the existing organization member to be added to the team.

inputs.name: team_id_or_slug
inputs.about: The ID or slug of the team to which the member will be added. Slugs are typically lowercase and use hyphens.

inputs.name: organization_id_or_slug
inputs.about: The ID or slug of the organization. Slugs are typically lowercase and use hyphens.

tools.name: Add team to project
tools.description: Grants a Sentry team access to a Sentry project within the specified Sentry organization.

inputs.name: team_id_or_slug
inputs.about: The unique identifier (ID) or human-readable slug for the Sentry team that will be granted access to the project.

inputs.name: project_id_or_slug
inputs.about: The unique identifier (ID) or human-readable slug for the Sentry project. Access will be granted to this project.

inputs.name: organization_id_or_slug
inputs.about: The unique identifier (ID) or human-readable slug for the Sentry organization. This organization contains both the project and the team.

tools.name: Bulk mutate an organization's issues
tools.description: Bulk mutate attributes on up to 1000 issues in an organization. IDs outside the selected organization, project, environment, or query scope are not mutated even though Sentry can return success. A 204 response means no issues matched and this action reports that no mutation occurred.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: Issue IDs to mutate. For non-status updates, this parameter is required. For status updates, it can be omitted to update all matching issues. If any supplied IDs are outside the selected organization, project, environment, or query scope, Sentry does not mutate them but can still return a successful

inputs.name: sort
inputs.about: Sort order for issues. Defaults to 'date'.

inputs.name: inbox
inputs.about: Mark issue as reviewed in inbox.

inputs.name: limit
inputs.about: Maximum number of issues to affect. Default: 100, Maximum: 100.

inputs.name: merge
inputs.about: Merge issues together. Requires multiple issue IDs.

inputs.name: query
inputs.about: Search query for filtering issues. Defaults to 'is:unresolved' if not specified. Only used when issue IDs are not provided.

inputs.name: status
inputs.about: New status for the issues.

inputs.name: viewId
inputs.about: View ID to apply view's query and filters. Only used when issue IDs are not provided.

inputs.name: discard
inputs.about: Discard the issues.

inputs.name: hasSeen
inputs.about: Mark the issue as seen.

inputs.name: project
inputs.about: Project IDs to filter issues by. Use -1 to include all available projects.

inputs.name: isPublic
inputs.about: Make the issue public or private.

inputs.name: priority
inputs.about: Priority level for the issue.

inputs.name: substatus
inputs.about: Issue substatus.

inputs.name: assignedTo
inputs.about: User or team to assign the issue to. Formats: <user_id>, user:<user_id>, <username>, <email>, team:<team_id>.

inputs.name: environment
inputs.about: Environment names to filter issues by. Used to narrow down which issues to mutate.

inputs.name: isBookmarked
inputs.about: Bookmark or unbookmark the issue.

inputs.name: isSubscribed
inputs.about: Subscribe or unsubscribe from issue notifications.

inputs.name: statusDetails
inputs.about: Status details schema for issue resolution.

inputs.name: organization_id_or_slug
inputs.about: The ID or slug of the organization containing the issues to mutate.

tools.name: Bulk remove an organization's issues
tools.description: Permanently removes issues from an organization. If IDs are provided, queries and filtering are ignored. Maximum of 1000 issues can be removed at once.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: The list of issue IDs to be removed. If provided, queries and filtering will be ignored. If not provided, it will attempt to remove the first 1000 issues matching the query and filters.

inputs.name: sort
inputs.about: Sort order for issues. Accepts: date, freq, inbox, new, trends, user. Defaults to date if not specified.

inputs.name: limit
inputs.about: The maximum number of issues to affect. The maximum allowed value is 100.

inputs.name: query
inputs.about: An optional search query for filtering issues. A default query will apply if no view/query is set. Only used if issue IDs are not provided.

inputs.name: viewId
inputs.about: The ID of the view to use. If no query is present, the view's query and filters will be applied. Only used if issue IDs are not provided.

inputs.name: project
inputs.about: The IDs of projects to filter by. Use -1 to include all available projects.

inputs.name: environment
inputs.about: The name of environments to filter by. Used to narrow down which issues to remove based on the environment.

inputs.name: organization_id_or_slug
inputs.about: The unique identifier (ID) or human-readable slug of the Sentry organization from which issues will be removed.

tools.name: Create an alert for an organization
tools.description: Creates a workflow alert for a Sentry organization using the New Monitors and Alerts system. Use when you need to set up automated alerting for issues based on trigger conditions and filters. Note: This endpoint is currently in beta and may change.

inputs.name: name
inputs.about: The name of the alert.

inputs.name: config
inputs.about: Configuration for the alert, typically includes 'frequency' in minutes. Valid frequency values: 0 (0 min), 5 (5 min), 10 (10 min), 30 (30 min), 60 (1 hour), 180 (3 hours), 720 (12 hours), 1440 (24 hours).

inputs.name: enabled
inputs.about: Whether the alert is enabled or disabled.

inputs.name: triggers
inputs.about: The conditions on which the alert will trigger. Must include 'logicType' (one of 'any-short', 'all', or 'none') and 'conditions' array. Available trigger conditions: 'first_seen_event' (new issue created), 'issue_resolved_trigger' (issue resolved), 'reappeared_event' (issue reappears), 'regression_e

inputs.name: environment
inputs.about: The name of the environment for the alert to evaluate in.

inputs.name: actionFilters
inputs.about: The filters to run before the action will fire and the action(s) to fire. Each filter has 'logicType' ('any-short', 'all', or 'none'), 'conditions' array, and 'actions' array. Conditions can filter by: level, age_comparison, assigned_to, issue_category, issue_occurrences, issue_priority, event_frequ

inputs.name: organization_id_or_slug
inputs.about: The ID or slug of the organization the resource belongs to.

tools.name: Create dashboard with widgets
tools.description: Creates a Sentry dashboard with widgets for an organization; `organization_id_or_slug` and specified `project` IDs must be valid, and `start`/`end` datetimes (if absolute range) must form a logical ISO 8601 range.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: Optional client-specified unique dashboard identifier; Sentry generates one if omitted.

inputs.name: end
inputs.about: Absolute end datetime (ISO 8601) for time range; 'start' must also be set for custom absolute range.

inputs.name: utc
inputs.about: If true, time range is UTC; otherwise, defaults to user's local time or organization settings.

inputs.name: start
inputs.about: Absolute start datetime (ISO 8601) for time range; 'end' must also be set for custom absolute range.

inputs.name: title
inputs.about: Title for the new dashboard.

inputs.name: period
inputs.about: Default relative time range (e.g., '24h', '7d', 'auto'); 'auto' is often 14 days. Overridden if 'start' and 'end' are provided.

inputs.name: filters
inputs.about: Additional key-value filters (Sentry search syntax for keys) for the dashboard.

inputs.name: widgets
inputs.about: List of widget configurations defining appearance, data queries, and layout.

inputs.name: projects
inputs.about: Project IDs to scope dashboard data; if empty/null, may apply to all accessible projects based on org settings.

inputs.name: environment
inputs.about: Environment names (e.g., 'production') to filter data; if empty/null, all environments included.

inputs.name: organization_id_or_slug
inputs.about: ID or slug of the Sentry organization where the dashboard will be created.

tools.name: Create external user for organization
tools.description: Links a Sentry user to an external identity provider's user within a Sentry organization; the Sentry user must be an organization member, an active integration for the provider must be configured, and `external_id` is typically required for the external user.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: The unique numeric identifier for the external actor linkage being created. Its specific use may depend on the integration or Sentry's internal handling.

inputs.name: user_id
inputs.about: The numeric ID of the Sentry user to be linked with the external identity.

inputs.name: provider
inputs.about: The external identity provider. Allowed values: `github`, `github_enterprise`, `slack`, `gitlab`, `msteams`, `custom_scm`.

inputs.name: external_id
inputs.about: The user's unique identifier on the external provider's platform (e.g., GitHub user ID, Slack member ID). This ID is specific to the selected `provider`.

inputs.name: external_name
inputs.about: The display name of the user as known on the external provider's platform (e.g., GitHub username, Slack display name).

inputs.name: integration_id
inputs.about: The numeric ID of the Sentry integration that corresponds to the specified provider and is configured for the organization.

inputs.name: organization_id_or_slug
inputs.about: The unique identifier (ID or slug) of the Sentry organization where the external user linkage will be created.

tools.name: Create organization alert rule
tools.description: Creates a Sentry metric alert rule for an organization, mandating a 'critical' trigger, typically for a single project, where actions may require Sentry integrations.

inputs.name: name
inputs.about: The name for the alert rule. Maximum length of 256 characters.

inputs.name: owner
inputs.about: The ID of the Sentry team or user that owns this alert rule. Can be a numeric ID or a string in the format 'team:<team_id>' or 'user:<user_id>'.

inputs.name: query
inputs.about: An event search query to filter events for the alert. For example, to include only transactions with status code 400, use `http.status_code:400`. Use an empty string for no filter.

inputs.name: dataset
inputs.about: The Sentry dataset this query will execute on. Valid values include `events`, `transactions`, `metrics`, `sessions`, and `generic-metrics`. Defaults to `events` if not specified. Refer to Sentry's [Metric Alert Rule Types] documentation for valid configurations.

inputs.name: projects
inputs.about: A list of project slugs to filter by. For metric alerts, this list is typically limited to containing a single project slug.

inputs.name: triggers
inputs.about: List of trigger configurations. Each trigger must specify `label` ('critical' or 'warning'; 'critical' is mandatory), `alertThreshold` (numeric value to trigger), and `actions`. Each action specifies `type` (e.g., 'email', 'slack', 'msteams', 'pagerduty', 'sentry_app', 'sentry_notification', 'opsgen

inputs.name: aggregate
inputs.about: The aggregate function used in this alert rule. Valid functions include `count`, `count_unique`, `percentage`, `avg`, `apdex`, `failure_rate`, `p50`, `p75`, `p95`, `p99`, `p100`, and `percentile`. Refer to Sentry's [Metric Alert Rule Types] documentation for valid configurations based on dataset and

inputs.name: queryType
inputs.about: The type of query. If no value is provided, `queryType` defaults based on the specified `dataset`. Supported values: `0` (Error events: event.type:error), `1` (Transaction events: event.type:transaction), `2` (None: for datasets like metrics that don't use this). See Sentry's [Metric Alert Rule Type

inputs.name: eventTypes
inputs.about: A list of event types this alert will relate to. Valid values are `default` (for events captured via Capture Message), `error`, and `transaction`.

inputs.name: timeWindow
inputs.about: The time period in minutes to aggregate over. Supported values: `1` (1 minute), `5` (5 minutes), `10` (10 minutes), `15` (15 minutes), `30` (30 minutes), `60` (1 hour), `120` (2 hours), `240` (4 hours), `1440` (24 hours).

inputs.name: environment
inputs.about: The name of the environment to filter by. If None or omitted, the alert rule applies to all environments.

inputs.name: monitorType
inputs.about: Integer representing the monitor type. This determines if the alert rule is actively monitored or monitored based on a specific activation condition. Consult Sentry documentation for specific values and their meanings.

inputs.name: thresholdType
inputs.about: The comparison operator for the critical and warning thresholds. `0` for 'Above' and `1` for 'Below'. The resolved threshold uses the opposite operator. For percentage change thresholds, `0` means 'Higher than' and `1` means 'Lower than'.

inputs.name: comparisonDelta
inputs.about: Optional. The time delta in minutes for the comparison period. Required when using a percentage change threshold (e.g., 'X% higher/lower compared to `comparisonDelta` minutes ago'). Cannot be used for Crash Free Session Rate or Crash Free User Rate alerts.

inputs.name: resolveThreshold
inputs.about: Optional. The numeric value the metric must reach to resolve an active alert. If not provided, it's automatically set based on the lowest severity trigger's `alertThreshold` and `thresholdType`. For example, if an alert triggers 'Above' 50, it might resolve 'Below' 50. If `thresholdType` is `0` (Abo

inputs.name: activationCondition
inputs.about: Optional integer. Represents a trigger condition for when to start monitoring the alert rule, typically used when `monitorType` indicates conditional monitoring. Consult Sentry documentation for specific values.

inputs.name: organization_id_or_slug
inputs.about: The ID or slug of the organization to which this alert rule belongs.

tools.name: Create organization monitor
tools.description: Creates a new monitor (type 'cron_job') within a Sentry organization to track scheduled tasks, allowing configuration of its name, slug (which must be unique if provided), status, owner, and muting preferences for incidents.

inputs.name: name
inputs.about: The human-readable name for the monitor. This name is used in notifications and the Sentry UI.

inputs.name: slug
inputs.about: A unique identifier for the monitor within the organization. If not provided, Sentry will generate one. It must match the pattern `^[a-z][a-z0-9_\-]*$`. Changing this slug after creation requires updating any instrumented check-in calls.

inputs.name: owner
inputs.about: The Sentry actor ID (team or user) to be designated as the owner of this monitor. Format: 'user:{user_id}' or 'team:{team_id}'. If not provided, the monitor will be unassigned.

inputs.name: config
inputs.about: The configuration for the monitor including schedule type, schedule, and timing settings. This is a required field.

inputs.name: status
inputs.about: The initial status of the monitor. 'active' monitors accept check-ins and contribute to quotas, while 'disabled' monitors do not. Allowed values: 'active', 'disabled'. Note: Monitors are typically created with 'disabled' status by default and must be activated separately.

inputs.name: project
inputs.about: The project slug to associate the monitor to. This is a required field.

inputs.name: is_muted
inputs.about: A boolean flag to control incident creation for this monitor. If true, monitor incidents (alerts) will be suppressed. Defaults to false if not provided.

inputs.name: organization_id_or_slug
inputs.about: The identifier (ID or slug) of the Sentry organization to which this monitor will belong.

tools.name: Create organization team
tools.description: Creates a new team in a Sentry organization, requiring either a 'slug' or 'name' to define the team.

inputs.name: name
inputs.about: Optional. The display name for the new team. If not supplied, it's auto-generated from the `slug` (if `slug` is provided). At least one of `name` or `slug` is required to create a team.

inputs.name: slug
inputs.about: Optional. A unique, URL-friendly identifier for the new team. If not supplied, it's auto-generated from the `name` (if `name` is provided). Must adhere to the pattern: `^[a-z][a-z0-9_\-]*$`.

inputs.name: organization_id_or_slug
inputs.about: The unique identifier (ID) or human-readable slug of the Sentry organization where the new team will be created. This organization must already exist.

tools.name: Create project key with optional rate limiting
tools.description: Creates a new client key (DSN) for an existing Sentry project, with optional custom rate limit configuration.

inputs.name: name
inputs.about: An optional descriptive name for the client key. If not provided, Sentry will generate a default name.

inputs.name: rateLimit__count
inputs.about: The maximum number of events that can be accepted for this key within the specified `rateLimit_window`. If omitted, no custom rate limit will be applied to this key.

inputs.name: rateLimit__window
inputs.about: The time window in seconds for the `rateLimit_count`. For example, if `rateLimit_count` is 1000 and `rateLimit_window` is 3600, the key will accept up to 1000 events per hour. If omitted, no custom rate limit will be applied to this key.

inputs.name: project_id_or_slug
inputs.about: The unique identifier (ID) or human-readable slug for the Sentry project for which the client key will be created.

inputs.name: organization_id_or_slug
inputs.about: The unique identifier (ID) or human-readable slug for the Sentry organization to which the project belongs.

tools.name: Create project rule for alerts
tools.description: Creates a Sentry project alert rule by defining conditions, actions, and optional filters using specific JSON structures (detailed in parameter descriptions) to automate responses to event patterns for an existing organization and project.

inputs.name: name
inputs.about: Descriptive name for the alert rule.

inputs.name: owner
inputs.about: Owner ID (e.g., 'team:ID', 'user:ID').

inputs.name: frequency
inputs.about: Action performance interval in minutes (5-43200) once conditions are met.

inputs.name: actionMatch
inputs.about: Logic for condition evaluation: 'all' (all conditions must match) or 'any' (any condition can match). NOTE: 'none' is deprecated and no longer supported.

inputs.name: environment
inputs.about: Sentry environment name for event filtering (e.g., 'production'). If omitted, applies to all environments.

inputs.name: filterMatch
inputs.about: Logic for filter evaluation ('all', 'any', 'none') for action execution. Required if 'filters' are specified.

inputs.name: project_id_or_slug
inputs.about: Unique identifier (ID or slug) of the Sentry project for the rule.

inputs.name: organization_id_or_slug
inputs.about: Unique identifier (ID or slug) of the Sentry organization.

tools.name: Create project webhook subscription
tools.description: Registers a new webhook subscription for a Sentry project to send HTTP POST notifications to a specified URL for given events, provided the project has the 'servicehooks' feature enabled.

inputs.name: url
inputs.about: The fully qualified URL to which Sentry will send webhook POST requests for the subscribed events.

inputs.name: events
inputs.about: A list of event types to subscribe to for this webhook. Valid event types are: 'event.alert' (triggered when alerts fire) and 'event.created' (triggered when new events are processed). When any of these events occur in the project, Sentry will send a notification to the specified URL.

inputs.name: project_id_or_slug
inputs.about: The unique identifier (ID) or human-readable slug of the Sentry project for which to create the webhook.

inputs.name: organization_id_or_slug
inputs.about: The unique identifier (ID) or human-readable slug of the Sentry organization to which the project belongs.

tools.name: Create release deploy for org
tools.description: Creates a new deploy record in Sentry to track the introduction of a release version into a specific environment.

inputs.name: url
inputs.about: An optional URL that provides a link to the deployment, such as a commit or a CI build page.

inputs.name: name
inputs.about: An optional human-readable name for the deploy.

inputs.name: version
inputs.about: The version identifier of the release to be deployed. This version must already exist in Sentry.

inputs.name: projects
inputs.about: An optional list of project slugs to associate this deploy with. If not provided, the deploy applies to all projects associated with the release.

inputs.name: dateStarted
inputs.about: An optional ISO 8601 formatted date-time string (UTC is recommended) indicating when the deployment process started.

inputs.name: environment
inputs.about: The name of the environment to which this release is being deployed (e.g., 'production', 'staging'). This environment must be known to Sentry.

inputs.name: dateFinished
inputs.about: An optional ISO 8601 formatted date-time string (UTC is recommended) indicating when the deployment process finished. If not provided, Sentry uses the time the deploy API call is received.

inputs.name: organization_id_or_slug
inputs.about: The unique identifier (ID) or human-readable slug of the Sentry organization.

tools.name: Create release for organization
tools.description: Creates a new Sentry release for an existing organization, associating it with specified projects that must belong to that organization.

inputs.name: ref
inputs.about: An optional commit reference, such as a branch name or a tag. This is useful if a tagged version has been provided (e.g., `version` is 'v1.0.0' and `ref` is 'refs/tags/v1.0.0').

inputs.name: url
inputs.about: An optional URL that points to the release. This can be a link to a GitHub release, a CI build page, or an internal changelog.

inputs.name: refs
inputs.about: An optional way to indicate the start and end commits for each repository included in a release. Head commits must include `repository` and `commit` (the HEAD SHA). They can optionally include `previousCommit` (the SHA of the HEAD of the previous release), which should be specified if this is the fi

inputs.name: commits
inputs.about: An optional list of commit data to be associated with the release. Commits must include the `id` parameter (the SHA of the commit). Optionally, include `repository`, `message`, `patch_set`, `author_name`, `author_email`, and `timestamp` for richer integration and better suspect commit tracking.

inputs.name: version
inputs.about: A unique identifier for this release. Can be a semantic version number, a commit hash, or any other string that uniquely identifies this release.

inputs.name: projects
inputs.about: A list of project slugs that are part of this release. These projects must belong to the specified organization.

inputs.name: dateReleased
inputs.about: An optional ISO 8601 timestamp indicating when the release went live. If not provided, the current time is assumed by Sentry.

inputs.name: organization_id_or_slug
inputs.about: The ID or slug of the Sentry organization.

tools.name: Create scim group for organization
tools.description: Creates a new Sentry team (SCIM group) within an organization via the SCIM API. Requirements: - Organization must have SCIM enabled (requires Business Plan with SAML2) - Must use a SCIM bearer token (generated when SCIM is enabled) - Token must have 'team:admin' or 'team:write' scope Behavior: - A URL-friendly slug is auto-generated from displayName (e.g., 'My Team' → 'my-team') - Team is created with an empty member set - Members must be added separately through SCIM member operations - Returns SCIM 2.0 Group resource with unique ID Use this for SCIM provisioning workflows with identity providers like Okta or Azure AD.

inputs.name: displayName
inputs.about: Human-readable name for the new team. A URL-friendly slug will be auto-generated by converting to lowercase and replacing spaces with dashes (e.g., 'My Team' → 'my-team'). Must be unique within the organization.

inputs.name: organization_id_or_slug
inputs.about: The unique identifier (ID) or human-readable slug of the Sentry organization where the new team will be created. Must be an organization with SCIM enabled.

tools.name: Create sentry external issue link
tools.description: Links an existing Sentry issue to an issue in an external service, or updates an existing link, requiring a configured Sentry App installation `uuid`.

inputs.name: uuid
inputs.about: UUID of the Sentry App installation, used to associate the external issue with the correct Sentry instance.

inputs.name: webUrl
inputs.about: URL of the external issue in the third-party service; should be a direct link.

inputs.name: issueId
inputs.about: ID of the Sentry issue to link to the external issue.

inputs.name: project
inputs.about: Identifier for the project in the external service (not the Sentry project ID), e.g., JIRA project key, GitHub repository name.

inputs.name: identifier
inputs.about: Unique identifier for the external issue within the third-party service (e.g., JIRA issue key, GitHub issue number).

tools.name: Create team project for organization
tools.description: Creates a new Sentry project for an existing organization and team, allowing configuration of its name, slug, platform, and default alert rules.

inputs.name: name
inputs.about: Display name for the new Sentry project.

inputs.name: slug
inputs.about: Optional unique identifier for the project (e.g., for URLs), auto-generated from the name if omitted. Pattern: `^[a-z][a-z0-9_\-]*$`.

inputs.name: platform
inputs.about: Primary platform or language (e.g., python, javascript, java) for SDK setup instructions and issue processing.

inputs.name: default_rules
inputs.about: Specifies whether to create default alert rules. If true (API default when parameter is omitted), an alert is triggered for every new issue. If false, no default alerts are created.

inputs.name: team_id_or_slug
inputs.about: ID or slug of the Sentry team to associate with the project.

inputs.name: organization_id_or_slug
inputs.about: ID or slug of the Sentry organization where the project will be created.

tools.name: Create user for SAML integration
tools.description: Creates a new Sentry organization member via a SCIM request for SAML integration; this action does not support setting secondary emails.

inputs.name: userName
inputs.about: User's email address, used as the SAML identifier for the new member.

inputs.name: sentryOrgRole
inputs.about: Organization role for the new member; defaults to the organization's default role. The `admin` role cannot be assigned in Business/Enterprise plans; use `TeamRoles` instead.

inputs.about: The absolute end time for the dashboard's time range, in ISO 8601 format (e.g., '2023-01-02T00:00:00Z'). If provided along with 'start', `period` is ignored. Replaces the existing end time.

inputs.name: utc
inputs.about: A boolean indicating whether the dashboard's time range should be displayed in UTC. `True` for UTC, `False` for the user's local time.

inputs.name: start
inputs.about: The absolute start time for the dashboard's time range, in ISO 8601 format (e.g., '2023-01-01T00:00:00Z'). If provided along with 'end', `period` is ignored. Replaces the existing start time.

inputs.name: title
inputs.about: The new title for the dashboard.

inputs.name: period
inputs.about: The relative time range period for the dashboard (e.g., '24h', '7d', '30d'). Replaces the existing period. If 'start' and 'end' are set, this is ignored.

inputs.name: filters
inputs.about: A dictionary of additional filters to apply to the dashboard data, replacing existing filters. Keys are filter names, values are filter values.

inputs.name: widgets
inputs.about: A list of widget configurations to be updated or set for this dashboard. This will replace all existing widgets.

inputs.name: projects
inputs.about: A list of project IDs to filter the dashboard data by. Replaces the existing project filter.

inputs.name: environment
inputs.about: A list of environment names to filter the dashboard data by. Replaces the existing environment filter.

inputs.name: dashboard_id
inputs.about: The ID of the dashboard to be updated.

inputs.name: organization_id_or_slug
inputs.about: The ID or slug of the organization the resource belongs to.

tools.name: Update organization member role
tools.description: Updates a Sentry organization member's organization-level role and team roles. The request sends an empty team roles list by default when team roles are omitted.

inputs.name: orgRole
inputs.about: Sets the member's new organization-level role (e.g., 'billing' for payments, 'member' for event access, 'manager' for project/team admin, 'owner' for full control). The 'admin' role is not assignable on Business/Enterprise plans; use `teamRoles` for granular admin tasks.

inputs.name: member_id
inputs.about: The ID of the member whose roles are to be updated.

inputs.name: teamRoles
inputs.about: List of team role assignments (each object specifying `teamSlug` and `role`). This list completely replaces existing team roles. An empty list (default) removes the member from all teams. Team roles: `contributor` (views/acts on issues), `admin` (full team/project management).

inputs.name: organization_id_or_slug
inputs.about: The ID or slug of the organization to which the member belongs.

tools.name: Update project details
tools.description: Updates a Sentry project's settings (e.g., name, slug, platform, bookmark status); `isBookmarked` can be updated with `project:read` permission, other fields typically require `project:write` or `project:admin` permissions.

inputs.name: name
inputs.about: The new name for the project.

inputs.name: slug
inputs.about: The new unique identifier (slug) for the project, used in URLs and the Sentry interface.

inputs.name: platform
inputs.about: The new platform for the project (e.g., `python`, `javascript`, `java`). This helps Sentry categorize and process errors.

inputs.name: resolveAge
inputs.about: The duration in hours after which an issue is automatically resolved if it hasn't been seen. Set to `0` to disable auto-resolution.

inputs.name: isBookmarked
inputs.about: Toggles whether the project is starred (bookmarked) in the Sentry UI.

inputs.name: highlightTags
inputs.about: A list of tag keys (e.g., 'release', 'environment') to highlight on this project's issues in Sentry's UI. For example: `["release", "environment", "server_name"]`.

inputs.name: subjectPrefix
inputs.about: Custom prefix for the subject line of notification emails sent from this project.

inputs.name: subjectTemplate
inputs.about: The template for the email subject (excluding the prefix) for individual issue alerts. Available variables: `$title`, `$shortID`, `$projectID`, `$orgID`, and `${tag:key}` (e.g., `${tag:environment}`, `${tag:release}`).

inputs.name: highlightContext
inputs.about: A JSON object mapping context types (e.g., 'user', 'device') to a list of their keys to be highlighted in Sentry's UI for issues within this project. For example: `{"user": ["id", "email"], "device": ["model"]}`.

inputs.name: project_id_or_slug
inputs.about: The ID or slug of the Sentry project to be updated.

inputs.name: organization_id_or_slug
inputs.about: The ID or slug of the Sentry organization to which the project belongs.

tools.name: Update project issue status and details
tools.description: Bulk updates attributes of issues in a Sentry project, selecting issues by ID or status. If IDs are omitted when a status filter is used, the update targets all issues matching that status.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: Issue IDs to update. Accepts a list of integers for bulk updates. Optional; if omitted and the 'status' query parameter (filter) is used, updates all issues matching that status.

inputs.name: merge
inputs.about: Set to true to merge issues, false to unmerge. If merging, ensure the target issue ID is correctly specified.

inputs.name: status
inputs.about: The new status to apply to the selected issues (request body parameter). Valid values are `"resolved"`, `"resolvedInNextRelease"`, `"unresolved"`, and `"ignored"`.

inputs.name: hasSeen
inputs.about: If called with user context: true to mark issue as seen by the user, false as unseen.

inputs.name: isPublic
inputs.about: Set to true for public, false for private.

inputs.name: assignedTo
inputs.about: Actor ID (e.g., `user:123` or `team:456`) or username for assignment. Use an empty string or null to unassign.

inputs.name: isBookmarked
inputs.about: If called with user context: true to bookmark issue for the user, false to remove bookmark.

inputs.name: ignoreDuration
inputs.about: Minutes to ignore this issue (alternative to `statusDetails.ignoreDuration`).

inputs.name: project_id_or_slug
inputs.about: ID or slug of the Sentry project.

inputs.name: organization_id_or_slug
inputs.about: ID or slug of the Sentry organization.

inputs.name: statusDetails__inCommit
inputs.about: Commit ID in which the issue is resolved.

inputs.name: statusDetails__inRelease
inputs.about: Version/release in which the issue is resolved.

inputs.name: statusDetails__ignoreCount
inputs.about: Number of times to ignore the issue before it resurfaces.

inputs.name: statusDetails__ignoreWindow
inputs.about: Time window (in minutes) for `ignoreCount`.

inputs.name: statusDetails__inNextRelease
inputs.about: Indicates if the issue is resolved in the next release.

inputs.name: statusDetails__ignoreDuration
inputs.about: Duration (in minutes) to ignore the issue.

inputs.name: statusDetails__ignoreUserCount
inputs.about: Number of unique users affected before a previously ignored issue resurfaces.

inputs.name: statusDetails__ignoreUserWindow
inputs.about: Time window (in minutes) for `ignoreUserCount`.

tools.name: Update project key configuration
tools.description: Updates configuration settings (e.g., name, status, rate limits, SDK options) for an existing Sentry client key (DSN), identified by `key_id`, within a specified `project_id_or_slug` and `organization_id_or_slug`.

inputs.name: name
inputs.about: New human-readable name for the client key. Name will not be changed if omitted.

inputs.name: key_id
inputs.about: The ID of the client key (DSN public key) to be updated.

inputs.name: isActive
inputs.about: Specifies if the client key should be active (`true` to activate, `false` to deactivate). Status remains unchanged if omitted.

inputs.name: rateLimit__count
inputs.about: Maximum number of events the key can accept within `rateLimit_window`. Uses existing settings or project defaults if omitted.

inputs.name: browserSdkVersion
inputs.about: Sentry JavaScript SDK version for the loader ('latest', '10.x', '9.x', '8.x', or '7.x'). Current setting remains unchanged if omitted.

inputs.name: rateLimit__window
inputs.about: Time window in seconds for `rateLimit_count` (e.g., 3600 for 1 hour). Uses existing settings or project defaults if omitted.

inputs.name: project_id_or_slug
inputs.about: The unique identifier (ID or slug) of the Sentry project whose key is being updated.

inputs.name: organization_id_or_slug
inputs.about: The unique identifier (ID or slug) of the Sentry organization to which the project belongs.

inputs.name: dynamicSdkLoaderOptions__hasDebug
inputs.about: Enable (`true`) or disable (`false`) Debugging features for the dynamic SDK loader. Current setting remains unchanged if omitted.

inputs.name: dynamicSdkLoaderOptions__hasReplay
inputs.about: Enable (`true`) or disable (`false`) Session Replay for the dynamic SDK loader. Current setting remains unchanged if omitted.

inputs.name: dynamicSdkLoaderOptions__hasPerformance
inputs.about: Enable (`true`) or disable (`false`) Performance Monitoring for the dynamic SDK loader. Current setting remains unchanged if omitted.

tools.name: Update project ownership settings
tools.description: Updates a Sentry project's ownership settings, including raw rules, fallthrough, auto-assignment and CODEOWNERS sync. CODEOWNERS sync defaults to enabled when omitted.

inputs.name: raw
inputs.about: Raw Sentry ownership rule string (e.g., 'path:src/components/* #frontend') defining issue assignment based on file paths or URLs. See Sentry's Ownership Rules documentation for syntax.

inputs.name: fallthrough
inputs.about: If `True`, assigns issues to all project members if no ownership rule matches; if `False`, no owners are set by default in such cases.

inputs.name: autoAssignment
inputs.about: Strategy for assigning new issues not covered by ownership rules. Options: 'Auto Assign to Issue Owner', 'Auto Assign to Suspect Commits', 'Turn off Auto-Assignment'.

inputs.name: codeownersAutoSync
inputs.about: If `True` (default), automatically synchronizes Sentry issue ownership with the repository's CODEOWNERS file during a release.

inputs.name: project_id_or_slug
inputs.about: The ID or slug of the Sentry project.

inputs.name: organization_id_or_slug
inputs.about: The ID or slug of the Sentry organization.

tools.name: Update project release file details
tools.description: Updates the name (path) or distribution identifier of a specific file within an existing project release in Sentry.

inputs.name: dist
inputs.about: The new distribution identifier for the file. Used to distinguish different builds of the same release version (e.g., build numbers or commit SHAs). WARNING: The Sentry API may not reliably update this field via the PUT endpoint; the 'name' parameter updates successfully but 'dist' may remain unchan

inputs.name: name
inputs.about: The new name or full path for the file. Use absolute paths (e.g., '~/dist/main.js') or URLs (e.g., 'https://example.com/app.js'). At least one of 'name' or 'dist' must be provided.

inputs.name: file_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the release file to be updated.

inputs.name: version
inputs.about: The version identifier of the release, e.g., '1.0.0' or 'my-app@2.3.1'.

inputs.name: project_id_or_slug
inputs.about: The ID or slug of the project associated with the release file.

inputs.name: organization_id_or_slug

tools.name: Update Project Rule By Id
tools.description: Updates an existing Sentry project issue alert rule by ID. Omitted fields may be cleared or reset to defaults.

inputs.name: name
inputs.about: The new name for the alert rule.

inputs.name: owner
inputs.about: The ID of the team or user that owns this rule. Format: `team:TEAM_ID` or `user:USER_ID` or the user's email, or a team name prefixed with '#'. For example, 'user@example.com' or '#platform-team'.

inputs.name: actions
inputs.about: Actions performed when rule conditions and filters are met. Structure varies by action type chosen; refer to Sentry's issue alert rule documentation.

inputs.name: filters
inputs.about: Optional filters refining when the rule fires after conditions are met. Structure varies by filter type chosen; refer to Sentry's issue alert rule documentation.

inputs.name: rule_id
inputs.about: The numeric ID of the alert rule to be updated.

inputs.name: frequency
inputs.about: The minimum interval, in minutes, between actions for the same issue. Valid range is `5` to `43200` (30 days).

inputs.name: conditions
inputs.about: Conditions that trigger the rule. Structure varies by condition type chosen; refer to Sentry's issue alert rule documentation.

inputs.name: actionMatch
inputs.about: Specifies how conditions must align for actions: 'all' (all true), 'any' (at least one true), or 'none' (all false).

inputs.name: environment
inputs.about: Specific environment for this rule (e.g., 'production'); applies to all environments if omitted.

inputs.name: filterMatch
inputs.about: Specifies how filters (if any) must align for actions: 'all' (all true), 'any' (at least one true), or 'none' (all false).

inputs.name: project_id_or_slug
inputs.about: The unique identifier (ID) or human-readable slug of the Sentry project.

inputs.name: organization_id_or_slug
inputs.about: The unique identifier (ID) or human-readable slug of the Sentry organization.

tools.name: Update release details for organization
tools.description: Updates an existing Sentry release's details for an organization, including its reference, URL, release date, associated commits, or repository references.

inputs.name: ref
inputs.about: Commit reference (e.g., a branch name, tag, or commit SHA) to associate with this release; useful if a tagged version has been provided.

inputs.name: url
inputs.about: A URL that points to the release. For instance, this can be the path to an online interface to the source code, such as a GitHub URL, or a link to a release announcement.

inputs.name: refs
inputs.about: Indicates or updates the start and end commits for each repository in a release. Head commits require ``repository`` and ``commit`` (HEAD SHA), and can optionally include ``previousCommit`` (SHA of previous release's HEAD) for initial data sends or corrections.

inputs.name: commits
inputs.about: List of commit data to associate or update for this release; can add new commits or modify existing ones if Sentry's commit tracking needs adjustment.

inputs.name: version
inputs.about: The version identifier of the release to be updated (e.g., '1.0.0', 'my-project@2.3.12'). This identifier must be unique within the organization.

inputs.name: dateReleased
inputs.about: ISO 8601 timestamp indicating when the release went live (e.g., '2023-10-26T10:00:00Z'). If not provided, Sentry uses the current time, but an existing dateReleased will not be overwritten unless a new value is provided.

inputs.name: organization_id_or_slug
inputs.about: The unique ID or human-readable slug of the Sentry organization.

tools.name: Update a saved query for an organization
tools.description: Updates an existing Discover saved query for a Sentry organization. If omitted, projects is sent as an empty list and the query dataset as error-events.

inputs.name: end

inputs.name: name
inputs.about: The new user-defined name for the saved query.

inputs.name: query
inputs.about: The Sentry search query string to filter results (e.g., 'error.type:ZeroDivisionError browser.name:Firefox'). Refer to Sentry's search syntax documentation for details.

inputs.name: range
inputs.about: The relative time range period for this saved query (e.g., '24h', '7d', '30d'); an alternative to specific 'start' and 'end' times.

inputs.name: start
inputs.about: The specific start date and time for the query's time range, in ISO 8601 format (e.g., '2023-01-01T00:00:00Z'); used if 'range' is not provided.

inputs.name: yAxis
inputs.about: A list of aggregate functions to be plotted on the Y-axis of the chart (e.g., 'count()', 'p95(transaction.duration)').

inputs.name: fields
inputs.about: A list of fields, functions, or equations for the query, with a maximum of 20. Each item can be: 1. A built-in key field (e.g., 'transaction'; see Sentry's properties table for event properties). 2. A tag, formatted as 'tag[tagName]' (e.g., 'tag[isEnterprise]'). 3. A function, like 'function_name(pa

inputs.name: display
inputs.about: The visualization type for the saved query chart. Allowed values are: 'default', 'previous', 'top5', 'daily', 'dailytop5', 'bar'.

inputs.name: orderby
inputs.about: Field to sort the query results by. Must be one of the items in the 'fields' list (excluding equations). Prefix with a hyphen '-' for descending order (e.g., '-count()').

inputs.name: interval
inputs.about: The resolution of the time series for the chart (e.g., '1h', '1d', '30m').

inputs.name: projects
inputs.about: A list of project IDs to associate with this saved query. An empty list means the query applies to all projects selected in the Sentry UI unless overridden.

inputs.name: query_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the Discover saved query to be updated.

inputs.name: topEvents
inputs.about: The number of top events' timeseries to be visualized on the chart.

inputs.name: environment
inputs.about: A list of environment names to filter the query by.

inputs.name: queryDataset
inputs.about: The dataset to query. Note: 'discover' is deprecated; use 'error-events' or 'transaction-like' instead.

inputs.name: organization_id_or_slug
inputs.about: The ID or slug of the Sentry organization to which the saved query belongs.

tools.name: Update team information by organization id
tools.description: Updates the slug for an existing team within a Sentry organization.

inputs.name: slug
inputs.about: The new slug for the team. Must be unique within the organization and follow the pattern: starts with a lowercase letter, followed by lowercase letters, numbers, underscores, or hyphens.

inputs.name: organization_id_or_slug

tools.name: Update user email
tools.description: Updates the primary email address for a Sentry user. tools.name: Update webhook configuration
tools.description: Updates an existing Sentry service hook's target URL and subscribed event types for a given project and organization. Service hooks (webhooks) are HTTP callbacks that notify external systems when specific events occur in Sentry. This action allows you to modify the webhook's URL and change which events trigger notifications. Valid event types are: - 'event.alert': Triggered when alerts fire - 'event.created': Triggered when new events are processed Requirements: - Authentication with 'project:write' scope - The 'servicehooks' feature must be enabled for your Sentry plan - The hook_id must be a valid GUID from an existing service hook Common use cases: - Updating webhook URL when your endpoint changes - Modifying event subscriptions to receive different notification types - Reconfiguring webhooks for testing or production environments

inputs.name: url
inputs.about: The URL to which Sentry will send webhook POST requests when subscribed events occur.

inputs.name: events
inputs.about: A list of Sentry event types to subscribe to. Valid event types are: 'event.alert' (triggered when alerts fire) and 'event.created' (triggered when new events are processed).

inputs.name: hook_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier (GUID) of the service hook to be updated.

inputs.name: project_id_or_slug
inputs.about: The ID or slug of the project to which the service hook belongs.

inputs.name: organization_id_or_slug
inputs.about: The ID or slug of the organization to which the service hook belongs.

inputs.name: dist
